memory_candidates.content: CSLib agents use a reuse-first search protocol: check Cslib.Foundations.* via lean_local_search before recommending any new definition, then check existing typeclasses (LTS, HasImp, HasBox, HasBot, HasDia, HasTop), then Mathlib via lean_leansearch. The Cslib.Logic namespace spans two directories: Cslib/Foundations/Logic/ and Cslib/Logics/.

CSLib CI pipeline has 7 mandatory steps in order: (1) lake build Module.Name, (2) lake exe checkInitImports, (3) lake lint, (4) lake exe lint-style, (5) lake shake --add-public --keep-implied --keep-prefix, (6) lake exe mk_all --module, (7) lake test. Step 2 (checkInitImports) is commonly missed and causes CI failure if Cslib.Init is not imported.
